dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You stand behind the counter. After a short while, a customer walks in...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, it's been a while since we last said hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Emilie! Paimon hasn't seen you in forever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's great to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME} are helping out behind the counter today. If you need anything, just let us know!

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, but I'm not here looking for help, quite the opposite in fact — someone asked me for help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Did Nefer...

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Indeed. I'm here at Lady Nefer's invitation... to help investigate a case.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: To be exact, a wealthy man suddenly passed away in his home, and all traces of the crime were destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: The only clue is a strange scent that lingered in the room.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: And since he left behind a vast fortune that needs to be dealt with, his family invited Lady Nefer to find professionals to investigate — for a hefty fee.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: She's put together quite a team in that short amount of time.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: A formidable fighter from Fontaine, a smart scholar from Sumeru, an insightful investigator from Inazuma, a resourceful merchant from Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And... you?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Yes! I'm the "Aroma Analyst."

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: That said, I was planning on visiting Nod-Krai anyway to look for new ingredients for my perfumes. This investigation is a happy coincidence, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: #Could you take a note for me, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: "Emilie has arrived in Nod-Krai and is ready to begin investigating."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll get it done.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Many thanks. I'd love to stay and chat, but I'm afraid I need to head back and organize my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: We should sit down and share a pot of tea, if you can find the time. I have a few stories I think you'd find most interesting.
